'''Michael Adams''' (also published as '''Mike Adams''')<ref name="dt-10331">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10331 More Than Just Mining Going On Up There], DeckTech (Michael "Yoda's Son" Adams, 9 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10331/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10331/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018122345/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10331/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Yoda's Son''') posted a [[Light]] [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] list on DeckTech in September 2000. He played West Virginia and Kentucky tournaments in 2000–2001 and finished 4th at the [[2001 West Virginia State Championship]].<ref name="tr-d2305" /><ref name="tr-d2315" />
